name: Ground

weightBudget.basis: One 35 mm sandstone pavement tile, rounded cobbles and shallow joints; 1024/512 colour atlases, lower resolution normal/ORM and Meshopt geometry.

reviewNotes: PDF page 2. Native 35 mm base reaches the body at 10 mm; exposed gritty earth from 14.45 mm with pebbles to 16.428 mm. Separate deep brown soil from warmer raised gravel, preserve irregular perimeter and small relief. Centre stand point must be measured from this source.
